entries.title: Genesis 19:1
segments: ¶And the two angels came to Sodom at even. And Lot was sitting in the gate of Sodom. And Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he bowed down, the face toward the ground,

entries.title: Genesis 19:2
segments: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and lodge, and wash your feet; and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way. And they said, No; but we will pass the night in the open place.

entries.title: Genesis 19:3
segments: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house. And he made them a repast, and baked unleavened cakes; and they ate.

entries.title: Genesis 19:4
segments: ¶Before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, from the youngest to the oldest--all the people from every quarter.

entries.title: Genesis 19:5
segments: And they called to Lot, and said to him, Where are the men that have come in to thee to-night? bring them out to us that we may know them.

entries.title: Genesis 19:6
segments: And Lot went out to them to the entrance, and shut the door after him,

entries.title: Genesis 19:7
segments: and said, I pray you, my brethren, do not wickedly!

entries.title: Genesis 19:8
segments: Behold now, I have two daughters who have not known a man: let me now bring them out to you; and do to them as is good in your sight: only, to these men do nothing; for therefore have they come under the shadow of my roof.

entries.title: Genesis 19:9
segments: And they said, Back there! And they said [again], This one came to sojourn, and he must be a judge? Now we will deal worse with thee than with them. And they pressed hard on the man--on Lot; and drew near to break the door.

entries.title: Genesis 19:10
segments: And the men stretched out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

entries.title: Genesis 19:11
segments: And they smote the men that were at the entrance of the house with blindness, from the smallest to the greatest; and they wearied themselves to find the entrance.

entries.title: Genesis 19:12
segments: ¶And the men said to Lot, Whom hast thou here besides? a son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and all whom thou hast in the city--bring [them] out of the place.

entries.title: Genesis 19:13
segments: For we are going to destroy this place, because the cry of them is great before Jehovah, and Jehovah has sent us to destroy it.

entries.title: Genesis 19:14
segments: And Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had married his daughters, and said, Up, go out of this place, for Jehovah will destroy the city. But he was as if he jested, in the sight of his sons-in-law.

entries.title: Genesis 19:15
segments: ¶And as the dawn arose, the angels urged Lot, saying, Up, take thy wife and thy two daughters who are present, lest thou perish in the iniquity of the city.

entries.title: Genesis 19:16
segments: And as he lingered, the men laid hold on his hand, and on the hand of his wife, and on the hand of his two daughters, Jehovah being merciful to him; and they led him out, and set him without the city.

entries.title: Genesis 19:17
segments: And it came to pass when they had brought them outside, that he said, Escape for thy life: look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain: escape to the mountain, lest thou perish.

entries.title: Genesis 19:18
segments: And Lot said to them, Not [so], I pray thee, Lord;

entries.title: Genesis 19:19
segments: behold now, thy servant has found favour in thine eyes, and thou hast magnified thy goodness, which thou hast shewn to me in preserving my soul alive; but I cannot escape to the mountain, lest calamity lay hold on me, that I die.

entries.title: Genesis 19:20
segments: Behold now, this city is near to flee to, and it is small: I pray thee, let me escape thither--is it not small? --and my soul shall live.

entries.title: Genesis 19:21
segments: And he said to him, Behold, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.

entries.title: Genesis 19:22
segments: Haste, escape thither; for I cannot do anything until thou art come there. Therefore the name of the city is called Zoar.

entries.title: Genesis 19:23
segments: The sun rose upon the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

entries.title: Genesis 19:24
segments: ¶And Jehovah rained on Sodom and Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Jehovah out of heaven,

entries.title: Genesis 19:25
segments: and overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew upon the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 19:26
segments: ¶And his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

entries.title: Genesis 19:27
segments: ¶And Abraham rose early in the morning [and went] to the place where he had stood before Jehovah;

entries.title: Genesis 19:28
segments: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and lo, a smoke went up from the land as the smoke of a furnace.

entries.title: Genesis 19:29
segments: And it came to pass when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.

entries.title: Genesis 19:30
segments: ¶And Lot went up from Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar. And he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 19:31
segments: And the first-born said to the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the land to come in to us after the manner of all the earth:

entries.title: Genesis 19:32
segments: come, let us give our father wine to drink, and let us lie with him, that we may preserve seed alive of our father.

entries.title: Genesis 19:33
segments: And they gave their father wine to drink that night. And the first-born went in, and lay with her father, and he did not know of her lying down, nor of her rising.

entries.title: Genesis 19:34
segments: And it came to pass on the next day that the first-born said to the younger, Lo, I lay last night with my father: let us give him wine to drink to-night also, and go thou in, lie with him, that we may preserve seed alive of our father.

entries.title: Genesis 19:35
segments: And they gave their father wine to drink that night also. And the younger arose, and lay with him; and he did not know of her lying down, nor of her rising.

entries.title: Genesis 19:36
segments: And both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.

entries.title: Genesis 19:37
segments: And the first-born bore a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites to this day.

entries.title: Genesis 19:38
segments: And the younger, she also bore a son, and called his name Ben-ammi; the same is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
